items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren is inactive today after appearing as GTD/Q.
items.why: Surprise inactive despite injury report listing.
items.implication: Colts TE streamers elevate; check Juwan Johnson/Freiermuth/Higbee.
items.opportunity: TE streaming opportunity in IND game.

items.text: Browns RB Quinshon Judkins (ankle, previously Q/GTD) is inactive/out today. Browns limited to Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime at RB.
items.why: Ankle injury; practiced once this week, pregame workout determined out.
items.implication: Browns RB committee collapses to unproven options; avoid all CLE RBs.
items.opportunity: No clear high-upside handcuff in player list.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts placed on IR (superficial blood clot), out indefinitely; Tanner McKee starts. Also Saquon Barkley out.
items.implication: Eagles offense limited; McKee/Pierce/Wicks/Goedert elevate short-term.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams is active and expected to start after hamstring absence.
items.implication: Bears offense upgrades; boost to CHI pass-catchers/RBs.
items.opportunity: Full snaps likely for Williams and supporting cast.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave and RB Alvin Kamara are active/expected to play.
items.implication: Saints skill players full go vs Giants.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson out again (ankle); Huntley starts. Ja’Kobi Lane activated/expected.
items.implication: Ravens run-heavy likely; Flowers/Henry/Andrews still viable but QB downgrade.

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown and RB TreVeyon Henderson (both Q/ankle) are officially active. NE near full health.
items.why: Sources confirmed likely then official actives; Brown activated from IR prior.
items.implication: NE offense fully stocked; start both with confidence.

items.text: Berry updated ranks: Cam Skattebo RB28 (still start for explosiveness/TD chance vs NO but riskier flex post-rotation), prefers Najee over DK in some spots; Foster Moreau TE1.
items.why: Rotation change risk but explosiveness edge.

items.text: Giants expected to change RB rotation: Najee Harris larger role, Cam Skattebo downgraded but still involved after fumbles. Skattebo 37th/43 in RYOE, 4 fumbles. All 4 RBs active.
items.why: Fumble issues + poor efficiency (RYOE); beat report on rotation change.
items.implication: Skattebo riskier flex/RB2; lower snap/carry share.
items.opportunity: Najee upside in split vs NO; monitor Tracy/Singletary.
items.conflict: Berry still prefers Skattebo explosiveness for TD chance but notes riskier.

items.text: Texans WR Marvin Harrison Jr officially active for London game debut. David Montgomery inactive.
items.implication: Harrison targets available; HOU RBs without Monty.
items.opportunity: Harrison WR upside; other HOU RBs elevate.

items.text: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel not expected to play (hamstring).
items.why: ETR weekend summary; confirmed across reports.
items.implication: SF WR targets consolidate to Evans (if active)/Kittle/others for MNF.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for remaining SF pass-catchers.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) remains GTD/questionable for MNF; no practice this week. Christian Kirk also GTD.
items.why: Missed all practices; Shanahan decision Monday.
items.implication: Monitor closely; if out, Kittle/Cooks spike. Berry loves Evans if active.
items.opportunity: If out, beneficiaries in SF passing game.

items.text: Steelers WR DK Metcalf expected to play (illness Q); confirmed active in reports along with Freiermuth, Dowdle.
Eagles signed/activated RB Jaydon Blue to active roster amid Hurts IR and Barkley out.
items.implication: PHI RB depth; possible committee with Pierce.

items.text: Berry loves Mike Evans (WR4) vs WSH for MNF due to Commanders defense being a buffet for pass catchers.
items.why: Matchup vs poor WSH pass D; usage bankable if active.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start if clears GTD.

items.text: Berry loves Drake London (WR6 vs CHI), George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH), Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI), Javonte Williams (RB8 @GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ) for volume/matchups.
Berry hates Jaylen Waddle (vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (vs PIT), Kyle Pitts (vs CHI) due to tough matchups and shaky QB/feeding issues.
items.implication: Sit/fade in favor of better options.

items.text: Berry hates J.K. Dobbins (vs SEA), Bo Nix (vs SEA), Justin Herbert (@KC) for tough Ds and low totals/scoring ruts.
